_meta.purpose: Mock airline dataset for Sprint 2 development, closing Gap 2 from the Week 3 schema stress-test (client's real airlines table is placeholder-only in local seed data).
_meta.usage: This JSON is a readable reference/documentation copy, kept in the team's own repo. It is not loaded directly by any running code, the existing airline feature reads from Postgres, not JSON. The same data is provided as SQL INSERT statements in the companion file seed_mock_airlines.sql, which runs locally only (docker compose up -d yaf-pg) and never touches the client's real production database. See mock-airlines-schema-doc.md Section 0 for the full explanation.
_meta.mirrors: client repo db/schema.sql, airlines, airline_sub_rules, airline_equipment_rules, airline_equipment_battery_rules, airline_equipment_battery_spare_battery_rules
notes: All airline_name, dimension, and weight values are invented for testing purposes unless otherwise noted in a 'source' field.
Only existing, frozen equipment_types codes used: wheelchairManual, wheelchairElectric, walker, crutches, electricScooter, powerAttachment.
Only existing, frozen battery_types codes used: lithiumIon, nonSpillableNickelDry, nonSpillableWet, spillable.
No new enum rows introduced anywhere in this file.
airline_name is a plain string in the real schema (not localized) — matches CREATE TABLE definition, not the yaf_localize_column list.

positive_message / negative_message / attention_message fields ARE localized in the real schema (JSONB {en, ro}) — kept as plain English strings here for readability; Dev to wrap in {"en": "..."} shape when seeding.
